title: System Experience
paragraphs: “If we destroy that invention…? There’s something more. It seems the Dragon Emperor who lived here discovered it, but it’s too damaged to repair yet.”
“Either way, we still have to go. So… let’s go.”
“I’m starting to get excited.”
Big sister’s friend declared enthusiastically while sitting on Kou’s head.
“Kou will do his best.”
“This is all for world peace.”
“Ugh… Sakura’s sleepy. I want to go home and help Mel-chan soon.”
“Kuro and Ren will become the Dark Messiah!”
Even the Filolials were showing their enthusiasm. Hah, there’s no need to trouble the Filolials with something so trivial.
Such a worthless invention!
“Oh my… things are getting pretty serious now.”
“Big sister Sadina, let’s do our best.”
“That’s right. If there really is a mastermind behind the Waves… I’ll make sure they get what’s coming to them.”

Big sister was smiling, but there was clear anger in her expression. Father noticed and explained the situation. Apparently, she was still angry about the murder of her parents and the villagers. She’s always been hard to read when it comes to emotions. Even I had to observe closely to notice.

“So the demons were acting with this purpose in mind. This is a huge discovery. I’ll have to compile this into a report and present it later… If I get the backing of the Four Saint Heroes, it’s guaranteed to pass.”
The doctor is truly a researcher at heart.

But if her publication helps the world understand the nature of the Waves and inspires people to take action, then isn’t that a good thing? That’s what Father was saying. And so, we passed through the open hall and proceeded down a path that looked like a basement. We made our way through a maze-like underground passage. There were traps along the way, but Father, proud of his exploits in the first world, dismantled them as we progressed. They were incredibly annoying. Moreover, since the demons replenished themselves and triggered the traps while passing through, getting past them was surprisingly easy. Eventually, after venturing deep underground… we found it. It was close to dawn, and a faint light could be seen. This place seemed to have once been a dome-shaped botanical garden. It looked more like an experimental site carved out of the earth. Before entering the site, there was something resembling a sign hanging on the wall. The faded letters seemed to say something.
“These letters are quite old… How do you read this again?”
“They’re ancient characters… um… system… experience…? What language is this? It looks like some kind of wordplay in hero language.”
“It literally means ‘experience.’ I see, so this really is a device for gathering experience points.”

In the center of the area, multiple layers of magic circles were carved into the ground, and in the middle stood a suspicious device that seemed to be producing demons. It looked as if something was being sealed beneath it, with red light gushing out from below the device. It’s like it’s holding back magma or something. Yet, strangely, there was no heat at all.
“Is that it?”
Something, perhaps vaporized energy, was swirling around the area. Father furrowed his brows as he observed it.
“It kind of reminds me… of the third installment of a certain game involving demons. Hearing words like gods and reincarnation made me think of that.”
“Do you know something about this?”
“Mm… probably not. It’s just that seeing this much visible power flowing around makes me think… this looks like a place where you could create an entirely new world.”
“Is that possible?”
The doctor tilted her head at my question.
“Who knows? But the energy patterns gathering here are similar to the ones reported at the activation sites.”

Hmm… it seems we’ve stumbled into an extraordinary place. Then, smoke spewed from the device, and demons were produced, charging at us the moment they spotted us. Upon closer inspection, they were the same dragon-type demons I had blasted away earlier.
“Hundred Sword X!”
“Gungnir X!”
“Arrow Rain X!”
Ren and I immediately intercepted them, while Itsuki rained arrows down on the demons following behind.
“Let’s keep moving!”
“Yeah.”

With Father leading the way, we advanced. The device was now right in front of us. The entire structure was fully visible. It had a very mechanical appearance. It looked like some kind of contraption straight out of a movie where a pig and a fly-man appeared, or like one of those suspicious devices with floating cylinders. Above it, something that resembled a mechanical eye could be seen. The machine emitted a whirring sound as it stared at us.
“Hello.”
“It spoke!? …English?”
As we stood there in shock, the device released another puff of smoke. As Father had suspected, it spoke in English.
What’s going on?
“Is it some kind of artificial intelligence? The technology of other worlds is really advanced.”
“An AI? That’s pretty common.”
“From what I understand, Ren’s world falls under the sci-fi category… The same goes for Itsuki’s world. And for you too, right, Motoyasu?”
As Father was explaining, the device continued to move its gaze, seemingly counting our numbers.
“You managed to break through the multiple layers of defense and reach this place…”
“It’s true that the defenses were quite formidable. But we’ve already obtained part of the treasure you were hiding—knowledge!”
Itsuki responded triumphantly.
Why is he answering?
“Just to confirm, are you… the device that caused the rampage in this land? I feel like I’m talking to a fool here.”
Father questioned the device just in case. In response, the device emitted a puff of smoke as if laughing and produced more demons. The device moved as if it were breathing.
“That’s right. I am the apostle of the god who collects experience from all over the world to prepare for the coming time.”
“The coming time… You mean the wave? I’d like to hear about that god. Will you answer?”
Father asked, but the device spewed out a swarm of demons to attack us. The name *Arch Demon* floated into view.
“Too easy!”
Itsuki pointed a copied rifle at the Arch Demon and pulled the trigger. A barrage of bullets fired from the barrel, hitting the Arch Demon right between the eyes and killing it.
Impressive.
If I remember correctly, that weapon was called Artemis, right?
“Looks like it’s not interested in talking, Naofumi.”
“I am the system that transforms the world. Everything is to purify this tainted world for the god. I was created to obstruct the heroes. Those apostles…”

“Using creatures that are neither human nor monster, unable to even communicate, to obstruct the heroes and aid the wave is unforgivable for anyone who exists in this world! The Dragon Emperor’s fragment that Gaelion obtained revealed the truth. You are the vanguard of the god rooted in the earth. You must perish for the sake of the world!”
Hmm, my rival is racking up points.
Shouldn’t I be doing something as well? As I was thinking that, more smoke was released. The magic circle beneath the device glowed red, pulsing as if it was drawing something in.
“What’s going on?”

“The purification of the contamination is progressing little by little, and I’m starting to extract information. That device… the System Experience has rooted itself in the world and is continuously siphoning experience from the dragon veins, preventing people from growing stronger.”
“What!?”
“Huh? What does that mean?”

What…? Siphoning experience? Now that I think about it, I had felt that we were gaining less experience than back when this was just a game. It seems Itsuki felt the same, as he voiced exactly what I had been thinking.
“That makes sense… I had noticed that the amount of experience gained from defeating monsters was far less than what I expected compared to the game.”
